content: Itou nomo nuuni beele no, asage gane nebere beele feiya tuwou.
Saini waha langa, Farisi bagu nere nuuni beele isou fai bagu Jerusalem awadu bode Yesus bagu maidu bode isoki tuwane,
“Adadu bona name disaipel nere asage gane nuuni beele higane waha feiyade? Saini nere da nyode ono bode, owonege ada huge-hugede.”
Ono wanenga Yesus no beele ege benou lenigai, “Adadu bona tere tage tebere onowou oojo boya, tere Itou nomo nuuni beele waha feiyaya?
Itou no lena, ‘Ne name amene anyane ngare neire huuna la yafa bonahe, neire beele oojowau,’ onodu ‘Fai no umamu yo, anya beele inyaba letuwona waha no umonbona.’
Onou wa tere benou le-leya, ‘Fai ete no umamu yo anya, hoyo tuwei nomo moni dada bagu, onou wa no leniron bona, “Ji Itou tuwei nomo amina hangadanaha.”
Ariya fai no waha, nomo umamu bona ninau isidu figini tuwei uwa.’ Onowou waha langa, tere Itou nomo beele ilei fu boya, tere onowou asatege gane langa tei waha isou-isouya.
“Tere fai yaawa hambawou. Profet Aisaia no tebere onowou tigini abiti tigai, saini no benou lewai langa,
‘Nere fai-aita bagu waha nere ji unyife nebere huranege langa isou-isoude, onode wa nebere isou huwanyanege bagu ji gai baae hiyou inyina.
Nere fai nebere nuuni beele wahanga malalamudu lebode, nere lede, “Beele beha Itou nomo beele.” Ono bode nere ji ewe unyife isou-isoude.’”
Yesus no dada fai jijiga nigina waha bona lena.
Onodu bona Yesus no fai-aita bagu yaure nigainga no bagu mayanenga lenigai, “Tere agudu, ninatege isi dewagu.
Dada fai hurau gamu langa goina waha, no jijiga bagu ada tafa tuwona. Uwa. Onou wa dada hurau no malalamu na wahanga, no fai jijiga bagu tafa tuwonbona.”
Iinga nere disaipel maidu Yesus benou letuwane, “Ne isiniru, nere Farisi name beele waha isidu, huwanyanege inyabanaru?”
Ono wanenga Yesus no ege benou gidu lenigai, “Ji yame Jijei ha laluwa langa yafana waha, no haga bagu. Onodu dada oruwa no nogo tataru wei uwa waha, no nebere jijiruku oruwa fasi wonbona.

Tere nere fai waha bonade aau adai tarigou. Nere agenege fosokowou dorofe, nere ila jala abiti nigode onode. Onou wa, fai ago fosokowou ilibumu jala abiti tubona wonga, nere ngadu u-u langa minode bodere.”
Ono wainga Pita no Yesus benou isoki tuwai, “Ne muuji beele waha nomo hugu lewahenga, ere isoboya.”
Ono wainga Yesus no lewai, “Adadu? tere fere foo tigei uwa?
Tere ada rute isiya, dada oruwanga hawege langa goina waha, no huwanyage langa minina, ono ganga huwanyage no heelu ganga mata menekale la mini-minina.
Onou wa, dada hurage no malalamuna wa, waha no ninage langa heigena. Onodu dada waha wenga fai ono tuganga jijigana.

Ji nere dada fai ninage langa heigena waha benou. Nere ninanege inyaba isidu, fai dukote wogunga umei nomo fanyimu, fai yo aita yo, te guruwou waha inyabamuwei nomo fanyimu, nere longi fanyimu, yebu nomo fanyimu onodu ila beele inyaba lenigou nomo fanyimu, kot langa yawa beele lewou nomo fanyimu.
Nere fanyimu waha fai ono tuganga Itou ago langa jijiga bagu heige-heigena. Onou wa, fai no da nyidu bona no amugedu owo ada hugena waha, no jijiga waha langa ada te-tena.”
Kenan aita Yesus bona huwanya ngalenga dewai.
Yesus no matane waha awadu ulate taon Tair, Saidon bagu la goyai.
Ono gainga Kenan aita ete no walanga yafa gai waha, no maidu bona yaurai. “Anyakaro, Devit Idau. Ne ji bonahe aau narou. Hauri inyaba yame aita magana inyabamu tudewaha.”
Ariya Yesus no bolou te tayei uwa. Ono wainga nomo disaipel nere maidu bode benou letuwane, “Aita waha gai yaurenga bona taga higina. Ne huuru tuwahe goyona.”
Ono wanenga, Yesus no ege gidu lenigai, “Itou no nere Israel fai-aita bagu wahanga, nere sipsip huwari wane waha hoyo nigei nomo bona huuru hiyai.”
Onou lenigi gainga, aita waha no maidu bona Yesus hinemu la afo tuburu kutudu, du turigainga oula langa minainga letuwai, “Anyakaro, ne hoyo hiyau.”
Ono wainga Yesus no aita waha letuwai, “Gamaji ere magana mene-mene nebere da waha, elegedu gauna ayaru nagoya wa hilou uwa.”
Ono wainga aita waha ka Yesus letuwai, “Anyakaro, wa ne ngalenga leni. Onou wa, gauna nere da matau amenege gane nebere tebol huna langa orososo ganga eiegedu nyi-nyide.”

Ono wainga Yesus no beele waha isidu bona aita waha letuwai, “Aita, huwanyate ngalengawou anyakaro. Dada ne langa heigei nomo gauni waha edo heigona bona. Taate dada ne waha boni huwanyate ngalengana waha tiginimu hanona bona.” Ono gainga saini waha la tigini, nomo mago ege jige tuwai.
Yesus no taura fai baingaro taura jigemu nagai.
Onodu Yesus no matane waha awadu bona golodu Galili yaage katiwou mou langa goyai. Onodu bona no muju langa digedu mani yafai.

Ono gainga, nere fai-aita bagu baingaro no bagu mayane. Ono bode nere fai afenege lalekawou bagu, nere agenege fosokowou bagu, nere ngedonege kobigou bagu, nere huranege fosokowou bagu, nere taura fai baingaro ila fere, nere Yesus afo hugu langa logosi wane. Ono wanenga no nere jigemu nigai.

Ono wainga nere fai-aita bagu ninanege baingaro isane. Wa taate bode, nere urane wa fai huranege fosokowou nere beele hayane, ono ganenga nere ngedonege kobigou wa tigini wai, ono gane fai afenege kaba tayou wa nere golowane. Ono ganenga nere agenege fosokowou wa, igei wane. Onou bode nere Israel nebere Itou unyi isou wane.
Yesus 4,000 fai da nigai.

Yesus no nomo disaipel yaure nigainga mayanenga lenigai, Ji nere fai-aita beha boni augami hina. Nere Ji bagu fati eei oruwa da uwau yafane. Ji nere huweli huuru nigei nomo awani, gamaji jala gama golo bode huweli bona agenege gui woga.
Ono wainga nomo disaipel Yesus letuwane, “Haumu belanga fai uwau. Ere bereti alanga elegedu boya, nere fai baingaro benou waha nigedenga nyode?”
Ono wanenga Yesus isoki nigai. “Tere beret agonyi inyina?” Ono wainga “nere letuwane, ere beret 7, hoowe mene-mene ila bagu.”
Ono wanenga Yesus no fai-aita bagu waha lenigainga oruwa oula la yafane.
Onodu bona no beret 7 waha hoowe bagu elegedu bona, Itou hauya tudu bona, lalatidu nomo disaipel nigai. Ono wainga nomo disaipel nere fai-aita bagu wese nagane.
Nere nyanenga ogonege bona, digai. Ono wanenga nere, da matau-matau awaru wane waha elegedu bode kekele 7 jiri wane.
Nere fai da nyane waha nere 4,000 onou, aita magana mene-mene bagu lelege nigegu uwa.
Onodu bona Yesus no fai-aita bagu huuru nigainga hara gane no bot digedu bona, Magadan nebere ulate la goyai.
